meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把本地记忆库备份到云端账号,并随时查看同步状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果担心本机 AI 记忆丢失,想备份同步到云端账号。
copy.tagline_en: Back up your local memory to the cloud account and check sync status anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you worry about losing local AI memory and want it synced to the cloud.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会查询本地 worker 的云同步状态,报告设备 id、待同步数量、上次成功刷新时间、SyncHub 可达性与错误;建立连接需你在自己终端运行安装程序并选 CMEM Pro 登录。
howto.when: 当你说「set up cloud sync」「sync my memories」「cmem pro」等,或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.text: 检查一下我的云同步状态
say.note: 会查询状态接口并汇报设备 id、待同步数量和错误

say.text: 怎么把记忆同步到我的 cmem.ai 账户?
say.note: 会引导你在自己终端运行安装程序并登录

say.text: 云同步好像连不上,帮我看看
say.note: 会报告 hub.error 并建议重跑安装程序

howto.what_en: Claude checks the local worker's sync status route and reports device id, pending counts, last flush, SyncHub reachability and errors. Connecting needs you to run the installer in your own terminal and sign in with CMEM Pro.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro" and similar, or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Reports device id, pending counts and errors

say_en.text: How do I sync my memories to my cmem.ai account?
say_en.note: Points you to run the installer and sign in

say_en.text: Cloud sync seems disconnected, can you check?
say_en.note: Reports hub.error and suggests re-running the installer
